## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `809de9ca8eb52bfeba2cec4774e27b863b93f8d8`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#11182 (body, triage `5907713921`, claim `5912386098`, dev report `5913121927`), PR objectui#11221 (body, 4-file list, net diff against `main` at merge-base `cfc9b6db98`), the 42 check-runs on the head, and the installed spec at the `@objectstack/spec@17.5.0` tag commit. Judged against triage's direction and the published contract, not against the report's prose.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The `action:menu` fix is the direction, verbatim.** `disabled` is destructured off `props` as `hostDisabled` before `...rest` (`action-menu.tsx:219`), so `rest` can no longer carry a `disabled` key, and the trigger draws `disabled={hostDisabled || loading}` (`:385`). Base drew `disabled={loading}` (`:369`) then spread `{...rest}` (`:371`), and `SchemaRenderer` hands every component `disabled: __disabled || undefined` with the key unconditional (`packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:2297`), so the present `undefined` re-declared the in-flight verdict. Right.
2. **No own gate invented for the menu.** The direction's OR has a third leg only where a renderer declares one. `ActionMenuPropsSchema` at 17.5.0 declares `actions`, `label`, `icon`, `variant`, `size`, `visible` and no `disabled` or `enabled` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:3085`); the registry `inputs` publish none; the renderer reads none. `hostDisabled || loading` is therefore the complete OR. Right.
3. **One rule, no second convention.** `action:button` (`action-button.tsx:64`, `:374`) and `action:icon` (`action-icon.tsx:91`, `:261`) destructure `disabled: hostDisabled` and lead the OR with it. The diff does the same in both renderers and adds no helper. The one residual difference (the menu spreads raw `rest`, button and icon spread `toFormControlDomProps(rest)`) predates this card and does not touch `disabled`, which is now off `rest` on all four. Right; the residue is answered in ③.
4. **`action:group`, measured, fixed for the half that reproduced.** Triage asked for it to be measured and fixed only if the forwarded `disabled` reached its wrapper. Base inline mode spread `rest` (with `disabled`) onto the wrapping `div`, where the attribute disables nothing, and base dropdown mode drew `disabled={dropdownLoading}` with no `rest` spread, so the verdict was dropped. The diff destructures `disabled: hostDisabled` (`action-group.tsx:247`), hands it to every `InlineActionButton` where it leads the OR ahead of the member's own declared gate and its `loading` (`:134`–`:140`), and puts `hostDisabled || dropdownLoading` on the dropdown trigger (`:382`). The in-flight half was not changed on the group, and it should not have been: the dropdown trigger never spread `rest`, and inline members hold their own `loading` inside the OR, so there was no second writer to remove. Right, and the scope held.
5. **No accept-set change.** The host-disabled path is the generic node gate `SchemaRenderer` already evaluates for every node (`disabled` then `disabledOn`, `SchemaRenderer.tsx:1885`–`:1898`) and already forwarded. Nothing in the diff adds, removes or re-shapes an accepted key, a registry `inputs` entry, a spec schema or a `defaultProps` entry. If the seat ever wants `disabled` published on the two blocks' props schemas the way `action:button` and `action:icon` publish it (`component.zod.ts:2857`, `:2940`), that is a `domain:spec` card and a Clause-② change; it is neither asked by the direction nor done here. Right.
6. **No public-surface change.** `export` lines at head and base are identical in both files (`ActionMenuSchema`, `ActionMenuItem`, `ActionGroupSchema`, `DropdownActionItem`). The `forwardRef` type arguments are untouched; only the non-exported parameter annotations gained `disabled?: boolean`, with the index signature still on the annotation, which is the exact shape `packages/components/src/__tests__/forwardref-props-annotation.guard.test.ts` accepts as fixed. `README Export Check` on the head: success. Right.
7. **The direct registry mount stays the control.** `action:bar` mounts the overflow menu with `schema` and `data` only (`action-bar.tsx:312`–`:327`), so no `disabled` key ever reached `rest` there and the trigger read `loading` throughout. After the fix `hostDisabled` is `undefined` on that channel and the OR collapses to `loading`, so the control's behaviour is unchanged. Right.
8. **Pins, read against the direction.** The new test uses the real `SchemaRenderer` and the real registry: an in-flight member keeps the trigger disabled on both channels and re-enables on settle; a host-disabled menu stays disabled (node boolean, node predicate, `properties.disabled`); a menu disabled mid-flight stays disabled after settle; an idle or false-gated menu is pressable; group inline members all disabled with no `disabled` attribute on the wrapper; group dropdown trigger disabled; no-gate and false-gate leave both group modes pressable. That is every pin triage named plus the group rows triage's "fix it here the same way" implies. The test's verdict on this head is the Test shards' to give, and they had not concluded at review time (see ③).
9. **Where the pass gates sit.** `Action Ref Convention`, `Build & E2E`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Bundle Analysis`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Pre-Install Import Graph Check`, `Shell Escape Residue Scan`, the five Doc checks, the three Skill checks and `Docs Route Eager Closure Check`: all `success` on the head. `Test (coverage)`, its shard and `dependabot`: `skipped`, not verdicts.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/11182-action-menu-host-disabled.md`: `'@object-ui/components': patch`. The diff touches one package, changes runtime behaviour inside two renderers, and adds no export, type member, schema key or input. Patch is the level the diff publishes.
- The prose, line by line against the diff and base source. Title: the menu trigger stays disabled while its action runs, and a disabled group disables its buttons: matches `:385` and `:134`/`:382`. "`SchemaRenderer` hands every component a `disabled` key, even when its value is `undefined`": `SchemaRenderer.tsx:2297`, key unconditional, holds. "The menu spread that key over its own in-flight verdict": base `:369` then `:371`, holds. "A menu mounted straight from the registry, which is how `action:bar` mounts its overflow menu, was not affected": `action-bar.tsx:312`–`:327` forwards no `disabled`, holds. "In inline mode it landed on the wrapping `div`, where it disables nothing. In dropdown mode it was dropped": base group inline `{...rest}` on the `div`, base dropdown trigger `disabled={dropdownLoading}` with no spread, holds. "As `action:button` and `action:icon` already did (objectui#9131)": `action-button.tsx:64`/`:374`, `action-icon.tsx:91`/`:261`, holds. "Disabled while the host says so or while an action is in flight. It re-enables when the action settles": `hostDisabled || loading`, holds. "A disabled group disables every inline member and its dropdown trigger": `:134`, `:382`, `:424`, holds. "An idle menu, and a group that no host disables, behave as before": `undefined || loading` and `undefined || gate || loading` are the base expressions, holds. No sentence claims more than the diff does.
- `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`: all `success` on the head.
- `Clause-②: no` holds: no schema accept or reject moves, no prop type or export is added or removed (① 5 and ① 6).

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared; none found.
- `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (raw `rest` on the menu trigger and the inline group wrapper, where button and icon filter through `toFormControlDomProps`): answered. Pre-existing, outside triage's direction, which governs `disabled` alone, and unchanged in effect for `disabled` because that key is now consumed by name on all four renderers. Not blocking. It is a registry-inputs parity residue of the objectui#11168 kind; the seat decides whether to file it there. Carrier stays none for this PR.
- `out_of_scope_findings[1]` (`autoTrigger` members run on a menu disabled from mount): answered. `useAutoTriggerOnce(action, isVisible, run)` takes only the visibility verdict (`auto-trigger.ts:146`), so this is the same on `action:button`; it predates the card and the direction does not name it. The settle row was rewritten in `06e5657081` so no pin rests on it. Not blocking. Whether an enablement verdict should also refuse an auto-trigger is a product question for the seat, not this PR.
- `deviations[0]` (full package run on `b9967bba99`, later commits narrower): verified. `git diff --stat b9967bba99..809de9ca8e` is the test file and the changeset only; `06e5657081..809de9ca8e` is the changeset only. The head's own check-runs are the gate regardless.
- `deviations[1]` (background run awaited in the foreground), `deviations[2]` (commit trailer spelling), `deviations[3]` (one test file named for the menu also holds the group rows): process and naming; no contract bearing. The three commit bodies carry a session URL and no model identifier.
- Serial constraint: objectui#11168 slice 1 (`3cc4fe567b`, PR objectui#11185) is an ancestor of the merge-base `cfc9b6db98`, so the card ran after it, as triage required. objectui#11212 is serial behind this PR on `action-group.tsx`; nothing here touches predicate fault policy.
- Check-runs not yet concluded on the head at review time, each `in_progress` and neither pass nor fail: `Test (shard 1/8)`, `Test (shard 2/8)`, `Test (shard 3/8)`, `Test (shard 4/8)`, `Test (shard 5/8)`, `Test (shard 6/8)`, `Test (shard 7/8)`, `Test (shard 8/8)`, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`. This record judges the contract; it does not stand in for those eleven, and the merge waits on their conclusions.
